request.deadline: Three-month staged liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; full delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with reserve-ratio safety mechanisms
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal/compliance work, disclosures, risk documentation, and go-to-market execution
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement
request.what: Fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer with reserve architecture, FIRE and ICE assets, dashboards, adapters, reporting, audits, legal/compliance work, go-to-market execution, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 will support protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, remain separate from operating spend, deploy in three monthly tranches, and return launch-liquidity profits, yield, and returns to the Cardano Treasury quarterly.

Pool 2 will fund delivery, audits, integrations, dashboards, legal/compliance work, reporting, administration, and go-to-market execution through itemized planning allocations totaling approximately USD 1.0 million.

Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve for FIRE and ICE, targeting an initial 5.0x reserve ratio with safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x to constrain minting, redemption, and risky activity under stress.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-backed claim, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset, both intended to be composable Cardano-native primitives.

The proposer states that Cardano currently lacks a serious production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that without Alchemy, Bitcoin-backed structured exposure will continue consolidating on other chains and off-chain markets.

The proposal cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, Pendle, and related markets as evidence that demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is real and growing, with several specific Strategy and Strive figures linked to external references.

The proposal identifies BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and proposes mitigations including overcollateralization, audits, economic modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, pause rules, disclosures, fund separation, reporting, and administrator oversight.

The proposer states that unused delivery funds, excess ada from price protection, and launch-liquidity profits, yield, and returns will be returned to the Treasury, while launch-liquidity principal may return only after a USD 60 million 30-day time-weighted average TVL threshold and a later governance approval.

The proposal states that Intersect will act as interim fund administrator if confirmed, otherwise an alternative independent administrator will be nominated after 30 days with community notice and constitutional review.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ada for a two-pool BTCfi infrastructure and launch-liquidity proposal by Sundial and Charms, with staged deployment, public reporting, administrator oversight, safety mechanisms, and several treasury-return commitments.
